meaning: Operari sequitur esse (owner request, #1103): with concrete meaning esse in re, the owner's causal principle (weak version: causal power and efficient causing) follows from three Aquinas readings. Causing, and having active power, require being in act in some respect (ST I q.75 a.2 co.; q.25 a.1 co.), and whatever is in act in some respect has being (q.4 a.1 ad 3). Not circular: causation and power are primitives of the signature, and concreteness is defined from InAct and esse, not from them. The derivation is conditional on its three premises, which remain open; it does not decide which candidates cause.
